changeSet.author: logos
changeSet.sql: CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY idx_log_entry_recent_full_model ON log_entry (model_id, timestamp_request DESC, id DESC) WHERE privacy_level = 'FULL' AND result_status = 'success' AND input_payload IS NOT NULL AND environment IS DISTINCT FROM 'model-provider-benchmark';

rollback.sql: DROP INDEX CONCURRENTLY IF EXISTS idx_log_entry_recent_full_model;
